description: Ministry of Higher Education - Order to amend the Gaz. Ex. No. 2105/31 adding conditions for degree programmes to the SLT Campus (Pvt.) Ltd.
reasoning: This gazette content is an order made by the Minister under the Universities Act, amending the schedule of recognized degree programs offered by a private company (S. L. T. Campus (Pvt) Ltd.). It deals with educational matters, specifically the approval and regulation of academic degree programs and their entry qualifications. This falls under "Educational matters" in the Miscellaneous category (Type 10), as it does not fit any of the government personnel/structure classifications (1-3) or the specialized categories (4-9).
